entities.name: Sliver Gravemother
entities.description: A Sliver queen who completed the ultimate evolution of conquering death and now rules an unknown plane overrun by Slivers.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Adaptable creatures once used as beasts of burden, now the Gravemother's hive.

events.summary: Beneath the surface, the Sliver queen patiently orchestrates generations of Slivers, each stronger than the last, until she conquers death.
events.quote: the Gravemother, finally completed the ultimate evolution: to conquer death

events.summary: In a single night the Slivers destroy the kingdoms of the plane; afterwards only what the Gravemother permits lives.
events.quote: In a single night, kingdoms were reduced to rubble as their former servants were joined by the Gravemother's hardened brood.

relations.quote: empires reduced to cattle for her hive to feast upon when the time calls for it
